Aisha (PM): Quick sync — need to land concrete scope for Console Observability work next quarter: dashboards, tracing hooks, per-customer cost breakdown, and error analytics. I want a minimal Phase 1 that gives customers actionable signals without blowing infra costs. Thoughts?

Tom (Eng): +1. Big risk is ingestion cost and dashboard query perf. We should pick a narrow set of KPIs and an index strategy early.

Priya (SRE): Suggest sampling at ingest and rely on prefix KV caching for high-volume traces. Retention tradeoff: 14d default, 90d optional for enterprise. Need to confirm storage estimate before prod rollout.

Diego (Data): For cost breakdown, we can map tokens -> route -> customer via existing billing tags. Proposal: per-route daily aggregate + per-request sample for traces to attribute outliers. That keeps dashboards cheap but enables drill-down.

Maya (Design): UX note — customers want 3 surfaces: overview (cost/latency/errors), hotspot explorer (by model/route/customer), and trace detail. Keep overview <4 cards for clarity.

Aisha (PM): Proposed Phase 1 scope (draft): 1) Overview dashboard: cost/day (per-customer), median latency, error rate, 95th latency. 2) Tracing hook: add model_id + routing_reason + customer_id into trace envelope. 3) Cost rollup: nightly job that aggregates per-route cost tags. 4) Error analytics: automatic grouping + top 10 noisy error signatures. Retention: 14d for traces/metrics by default. Launch criteria: 3 pilot customers, dashboard load <600ms median for common queries, and no more than 10% increase in telemetry infra cost vs baseline.

Tom (Eng): Implementation notes: tracing hook should be a small header in RPC path — e.g., set `X-RW-Trace-Meta: model=redwood-v1;route=/api/v1/generate;reason=fallback`. We can backfill routing_reason for recent logs if needed.

Priya (SRE): Agree on header approach. Also propose sampling rules: 100% sampling for errors, 1% for success traces by default, override=customer-request. Will need a flag for dedicated clusters to sample more.

Diego (Data): For nightly cost rollup, we'll produce both per-customer and per-route CSVs and feed into metabase/dashboard. Metric names: `console.cost.daily`, `console.latency.p50`, `console.errors.rate`.

Maya (Design): I'll put a quick mock for the overview by EOD. Keep card names: "Cost (24h)", "Latency (p50/p95)", "Errors (rate)", "Top Model/Route".

Raj (Product Ops): Questions: what do we consider a pilot customer? Should have at least one high-volume SaaS and one enterprise security customer. Also set rollout plan: internal -> beta customers -> GA. Timebox: 8 weeks.

Aisha (PM): Pilot definition: 1 production tenant with >5k tokens/day and 2 additional tenants with different workloads (chat vs batch). Timeline: 8 weeks to beta, 4 weeks of pilots.

Tom (Eng): Risks: if we include embeddings-heavy tenants, cost per token attribution gets noisy. Suggest we gate embeddings attribution to Phase 2.

Priya (SRE): Ops alerting: create SLO on telemetry pipeline: ingestion latency <10s 99th, processing success rate >99.5%. Also alert if telemetry cost delta > 15% week-over-week during rollout.

Diego (Data): Action item: I'll run a 14d storage estimate for traces with 1% sampling and 100% error capture by tomorrow and post numbers.

Maya (Design): Action item: mock posted — https://figma.redwood/examples/observability-overview (placeholder).

Aisha (PM): Decisions captured: 1) Phase 1 limited to request tracing + nightly cost rollups + 14d retention. 2) Sampling defaults (1% successes / 100% errors). 3) Launch criteria: 3 pilots, dashboard perf <600ms median, infra cost delta <=10%. 4) Embeddings attribution deferred to Phase 2.

console-bot: New ticket created: PRODOBS-412 "Observability Phase 1: dashboards + trace hooks + cost rollup" assigned to @Tom (Eng) and @Diego (Data).

Tom (Eng): I'll split PRODOBS-412 into infra + tracing + dashboard tasks and tag owners. ETA: infra + tracing PRs in 3 weeks, dashboard prototype in 5.

Priya (SRE): I'll add runbook skeleton for telemetry incidents to the ticket.

Aisha (PM): Great—next sync Friday 10am. Please add any missing risks in the ticket and flag blockers early. :thumbsup:
